title: Title: We're building a sales forecasting tool in Spain. Looking for small businesses interested in testing it for free.
author: Rare_Reference3909
selftext:
Hi everyone!

I'm working on Nexyria, an independent technology project based in Spain, focused on developing predictive intelligence tools for real-world applications.

One of the products we're currently building is APEX Retail, a tool designed to help small businesses and retailers better understand their sales data and forecast future sales.

The system uses our own predictive engine to analyze historical sales data and automatically select forecasting models.

Where are we now?

We've already built a working prototype that can process sales data and generate forecasts. We're currently improving the dashboard, completing the platform, and preparing further validation.

What are we looking for?

We're looking for a few small businesses, independent retailers, or online stores that might be interested in joining our first free pilot program once the platform is ready.

Participants would be able to:

- Test the forecasting tool for free during the pilot.
- Analyze their historical sales data.
- Explore sales forecasts generated by our predictive engine.
- Share feedback to help us improve the product.

A quick clarification: APEX Retail is still under development. We're not selling anything, and we're not claiming proven forecasting improvements at this stage.

We simply want to connect with real business owners, understand their needs, and see whether our technology can provide practical value.

Interested?

Feel free to send me a private message. No need to share any business data right now.

We'll reach out when the pilot is ready.

Thanks for reading! Any feedback or suggestions are also very welcome.

NEXYRIA — Predictive Intelligence | Built in Spain 🇪🇸
